link_preview.title: Preview: Bass OS v14, with Lindroid amd64 (only working for VT so far)
link_preview.description_html:
This is a preview of Bass OS v14 (Android 14) with the Lindroid addon.
The current state of development on Lindroid is still a WIP for x86/x86_64, so we don't have display passthrough to Wayland yet for Android-x86 based builds. But we can run any Linux…
